description: List the site sessions the user has connected, with each one's health, domains and scopes, or revoke one so it can no longer be used. action=list (default) is read-only; action=revoke needs session_id and cannot be undone, so only revoke when the user asks. Cookie values are never returned. A handle from here goes into alterlab_task_start.

session_id.description: Session handle to revoke. Revoke only

name: alterlab_sessions
title: Connected Sessions
